blocked.label: Eco
blocked.reason: Eco Portal (portal.eco.com, Eco's official transfer UI) does not offer Solana or BNB Chain as origin or destination (chains: Arbitrum, Base, Celo, Ethereum, Ink, Optimism, Plasma, Polygon, Sonic, Unichain), so no SOL<->ETH/BSC/Base USDC route can be quoted there. The UI itself quotes without a wallet for supported chains (e.g. Base->Ethereum 100 USDC -> 100 USDC).

blocked.label: NEAR Intents
blocked.reason: Official NEAR Intents app (app.near-intents.org) is decommissioned and just points to near.com; near.com's swap requires signing in / creating an account (passkey or wallet). The public landing-page demo swap has no chain selector (one unified USDC = Ethereum USDC), so no SOL<->EVM USDC route can be quoted.

blocked.label: Rhino.fi
blocked.reason: No public web UI: app.rhino.fi redirects to rhino.fi/b2c-app-deprecation (retail app deprecated Aug 2026; B2B/Console only, requires an account)

issues.title: Relay priced ~20.6 bps below relay.link on every EVM → Solana route
issues.detail: Bridg's Relay row is 25.6 bps under relay.link on ETH→SOL, BSC→SOL and Base→SOL in every sample; 5 bps is Bridg's own fee, leaving ~0.21 USDC more 'Relay fee'. Solana-source routes match. Hypothesis (unverified): Bridg's quote includes Solana USDC token-account rent that relay.link omits when no recipient wallet is set.

issues.title: LI.FI and SimpleSwap rows are far below their own sites
issues.detail: LI.FI: 45–97 bps below jumper.exchange on every route (one Bridg breakdown showed a 1.0167 USDC 'Lifi fee'). SimpleSwap: 47–130 bps below simpleswap.io's default floating 'Best rate' card. Hypothesis (unverified): different route/rate type or an integrator fee in Bridg's requests.

issues.title: Bridg lists venues whose own site can't quote these routes
issues.detail: Rhino.fi (Bridg's best price on SOL→BSC) — retail app shut down Aug 2026. Eco — its portal has no Solana or BNB Chain, yet Bridg lists Eco on SOL↔ETH/Base. NEAR Intents — public app moved behind a login. These rows can't be checked against a public UI.

issues.title: Across missing from Bridg on 4 of 6 routes
issues.detail: Not listed on ETH→SOL, BSC→SOL, Base→SOL or SOL→BSC although across.to quotes 99.98–99.99. Where listed (SOL→ETH, SOL→Base) it matches exactly net of Bridg's fee.

issues.title: Meson, Husher and Allbridge look like flat estimates on Bridg
issues.detail: Their Bridg rows are exactly 99.85005 (= 99.9 × 0.9995) or 99.45025 (= 99.5 × 0.9995): round outputs minus Bridg's 5 bps. Husher's own site is 0.10–0.20 USDC lower (Bridg +15 bps higher); Meson's is +4 to +40 bps lower or 10 bps higher depending on route. Allbridge happens to match (its site shows 99.90). Hypothesis: static fee models rather than live quotes.

issues.title: Layerswap 3–13.5 bps below layerswap.io
issues.detail: Consistent across samples: −13.5 bps on Solana-source routes, −3 to −8 bps on routes into Solana, after adding back Bridg's fee.

issues.title: CCTP gap is a comparison limit, not a verdict
issues.detail: Circle's own bridge has no Solana, so CCTP is read from Portal (Wormhole). Portal hides its executor fee until a wallet connects, so its 99.99 is before that fee; Bridg's 98.67 on SOL→ETH (−127 bps) likely includes Ethereum destination gas.

issues.title: Bridg's fee isn't applied to every venue
issues.detail: deBridge and Symbiosis match their own sites before adding back Bridg's 5 bps — Bridg appears not to take its fee on those rows. deBridge's own site adds a 1.05–2.58 USDC fee on top of the input that varies between loads; compared as out − fee, so Solana-source deBridge gaps swing.

issues.title: Matches
issues.detail: Skip Go (+1 to +2 bps), Allbridge Core (0.0), Across where listed (0.0), Mayan on most routes, and Relay on Solana-source routes match their own sites net of Bridg's fee.

issues.title: Display quirks and anomalies
issues.detail: Jumper once showed 120.36 USDC out for 100 in (excluded). Mayan, Meson and Husher show only 1–4 decimals. Across's input sometimes stays disabled on BSC→SOL. Allbridge charges a relayer fee on top in SOL/ETH (not converted). BSC 'USDC' is Binance-Peg USDC (18 dp, bridged) on every site.
